visibilityClasses.description: Approved public project content, still subject to entitlement and lifecycle rules.
Content visible to active permitted Campaign participants.
Content visible only to named participants or roles.
Content visible to the current authorized controller set and GM when policy permits.
Content visible only to the owning Player unless explicitly shared by an approved workflow.
Content visible only to active GMs and explicitly delegated Assistant GMs.
Content visible to the author, assigned reviewers, and owner authority.
Operational evidence available to authorized administrators without protected play content.
Security and incident data available only to narrowly authorized roles.
Credentials, tokens, keys, and equivalent data never sent to ordinary clients or AI.

surfaces.name: Navigation and workspace availability
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Generate navigation and counts from the authorized set; never rely only on hidden client controls.

surfaces.name: Universal Object result list
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Filter before ranking, pagination, grouping, and serialization.

surfaces.name: Search counts and facets
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Compute counts and facet values only from the authorized result set.

surfaces.name: Autocomplete, aliases, and recent searches
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Subject-scope suggestions and aliases; return no protected label for unauthorized candidates.

surfaces.name: Exact stable-ID and direct URL lookup
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Use not-found-or-unavailable response when precise denial would reveal protected existence.

surfaces.name: Object summary and inspector fields
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Build server-side field-safe projection; hidden fields never reach client state.

surfaces.name: Provenance and original-source view
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Authorize source and provenance separately from object summary access.

surfaces.name: Relationships and dependency traversal
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Return an edge only when its classification and required endpoint projections are permitted.

surfaces.name: Version, variant, conflict, and supersession comparison
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Authorize each comparison candidate and every displayed field.

surfaces.name: Object picker and selection receipt
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Reauthorize object, caller, field, entitlement, pack state, and current version at selection time.

surfaces.name: Character sheet and controller data
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Separate Campaign membership, Character control, GM authority, and Player-private fields.

surfaces.name: Player-private notes
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Owner-only by default; exclude from GM, Owner/Admin, Campaign export, diagnostics, and AI absent explicit approved policy.

surfaces.name: GM Scene truth and reveal state
surfaces.requiredBehavior: GM projection and Player projection are separately generated; reveal is an attributable authoritative event.

surfaces.name: GM preview as Player
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Generate preview through the same server projection contract used for the selected Player.

surfaces.name: Clues, evidence, hypotheses, and GM truth
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Classify facts, hypotheses, reveals, and GM truth independently and preserve reveal history.

surfaces.name: Relationship history and hidden motives
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Filter edge, fields, thresholds, and history events independently.

surfaces.name: Action proposal and GM approval
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Provide distinct Player and GM proposal projections while retaining one authoritative result.

surfaces.name: Realtime subscriptions and publication
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Authorize each subscription and produce recipient-specific server projections.

surfaces.name: Notifications and queue counts
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Filter existence, count, preview, sender, action, and deep link.

surfaces.name: Activity history and timeline
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Generate role-safe event projection; do not expose raw append-only events directly.

surfaces.name: Campaign and user exports
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Export from authorized projections; bind artifact to subject, scope, policy version, expiry, and checksum.

surfaces.name: Backups, restore, and provider exit
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Operationally restricted, encrypted, audited, and never exposed through ordinary user-export permissions.

surfaces.name: Object-storage media and artifact access
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Issue scoped, expiring access after authorization; never treat possession of URL as authority.

surfaces.name: Diagnostics and issue reports
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Use privacy-safe identifiers and reason codes; protected content is opt-in and separately governed.

surfaces.name: AI retrieval and response
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Use initiating subject projection plus narrower AI policy; recheck tool actions and output links.

surfaces.name: Caches and bounded offline snapshots
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Bind subject, scope, policy version, entitlement state, issue time, expiry, and digest; no offline authoritative mutation.

surfaces.name: Role, delegation, control, and ownership mutations
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Reauthorize at execution, use expected version and idempotency, append event, and invalidate projections.

surfaces.name: Owner support access
surfaces.requiredBehavior: Require explicit purpose, Campaign, fields, subject, duration, owner approval, attribution, and automatic expiry.

requiredDeniedCases: Player exact-ID lookup of unrevealed clue
Player alias lookup of hidden NPC
Player relationship traversal to hidden endpoint
Content Creator access to unrelated Campaign
Owner/Admin without Campaign or support-access role
service actor using another service capability
export containing another Player private note
pagination token replayed by another subject
implementationBoundary: Design complete. Implementation remains dependency-gated by the active P9-06 sequence and requires provider-neutral identity, persistence, database isolation, backup, restore, provider-exit, realtime, export, AI, and caller integration.
